question: What does the Autel EVO Max 4N do when the control link is lost, and do incident reports match?

focus: Autel EVO Max 4N lost control/link behavior
reason: Question asks what the aircraft does when control link is lost and whether incident reports align with those behaviors.

claims.text: When the control link is lost, FAA guidance indicates to try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft; if not possible, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: If control inputs are not synchronized or delayed, discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
claims.quote: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
conditions: control inputs are not synchronized or delayed

claims.text: The manual states that transfer of control between certificated remote pilots may occur, and another remote pilot may take over as remote PIC by positively communicating the transfer of control.
claims.quote: Another remote pilot may take over as remote PIC by positively communicating the transfer of control.

claims.text: When the C2 link is lost, the drone enters a reconnection state and will continue to attempt to reconnect; if the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
conditions: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection

claims.text: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected,” and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly.
claims.quote: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected.”
conditions: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds

claims.text: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
claims.quote: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
conditions: During automatic RTH caused by signal loss

claims.text: The drone’s Signal Lost behavior options include Return to Home, Hover, and Land, and Signal Loss Action options include Continue mission and Auto RTH.
claims.quote: The drone’s Signal Lost behavior options include Return to Home, Hover, and Land.
conditions: Signal Lost behavior options: Return to Home, Hover, Land

claims.text: If the C2 link between the drone and the remote controller is lost for more than 10 seconds, the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.
claims.quote: If the C2 link between the drone and the remote controller is lost for more than 10 seconds (e.g., remote controller power-off), the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.
conditions: C2 link lost for more than 10 seconds

reason: short answer over the limits after one retry

text: FAA guidance suggests reestablishing the control link or initiating emergency/contingency procedures after loss of control link, and to discontinue flight if control inputs are not synchronized. Autel EVO Max 4N manuals describe a reconnection state with automatic return of control if reconnected within 10 seconds, otherwise the app shows a warning and the drone executes the configured Signal Loss Action, continuing to try to reconnect during auto RTH, with Signal Loss Action triggered if the link is lost for more than 10 seconds. Unverified incident reports claim loss of control shortly after takeoff, continued uncontrolled flight away from input, failed Return To Home, and the platform not being located or recovered.
